newsitem.title: UK: MED OIL PRODUCTS MIXED - GAS OIL DOWN, MOGAS UP.
newsitem.headline: MED OIL PRODUCTS MIXED - GAS OIL DOWN, MOGAS UP.

text.p: Mediterranean oil products were mixed on Wednesday with gas oil easing, gasoline firming and fuel oil quiet.
Gas oil eased 75 cents across the board. September IPE settled 75 cents down at $170.00 a tonne.
Spot physical trade remained listless, with the heating oil market dulled by summer heat and holidaying senior traders.

Russian heating oil was assessed nominally at a $2.50 premium over cif Med high basis Genoa. A European trader offered Italian low sulphur diesel cargoes at low numbers around September IPE +$1.50 but failed to secure business.
Other traders said the action appeared aimed at depressing spreads to enable an arbitrage to the north.

High sulphur fuel continued the week's quiet trend, with a balanced market seen by most traders despite some reported attempts by one or two traders to move quotes either way from the $82/$85 fob mark.
Bunker spec was particularly low in supply and a refiner was still looking around in the northern European market for a cargo.
One percent levels indicated by traders hovered around $104/$106 cif for a fixed price cargo although a second cargo, 25,000 to 30,000 tonnes, was being talked on a formula basis.
Traders said there were unconfirmed reports of a trader looking for a cargo to go to Lebanon but some cast doubt on this saying that the country was covered for the moment.
Gasoline was tight with material attracting strong numbers. Dealers said Italian grade would be able to secure high cif quotes +$3-4.
